strictJson.method: Python json.loads over data/catelog, data/markets, data/history, data/schemas, data/evidence with object_pairs_hook rejecting duplicate keys and parse_constant rejecting NaN/Infinity (guide section 7.11.1).

jsonSchema.reason: No installed Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validator (no Python jsonschema module, no Node ajv) and no dependency was installed without authorization.

supplementaryCheck.method: Manual field-by-field conformance script written directly against the text of rolex-market.schema.json, rolex-price-history.schema.json, and rolex-catalog.schema.json: verified exact top-level key sets (additionalProperties:false equivalent), required fields, marketCode/modelReference/currencyCode regex patterns, enum values for priceType/listingStatus, taxRatePercent range, listed-price integer/non-negative rule, null price for non-listed statuses, source/alias/nickname object shapes (including that any watch with non-empty localNicknames.names also has non-empty sources), and URI validity, for the new HK market and history files, plus re-verified the catalog's structural invariants after the sourceMarketCodes edit.

crossFileConsistency.method: The guide's Node.js cross-file invariant script (section 7.11.2), run unmodified against this repo's data/catelog, data/markets, data/history paths.

sourceReconciliation.method: Programmatic reconciliation of all 1,465 evidence observations against data/markets/rolex-hong-kong-market.json (modelName, caseDescription, dialDescription, isNewModel, productUrl) and data/history/HK/rolex-price-history.json (currency, last listed price). 0 mismatches in either direction; 0 market watches were orphaned from the evidence observations.

websiteCompleteness.notes: Stop condition was the structured endpoint itself: a single request with numberOfResults=2000 (exceeding the true total) returned results.length === totalCount === 1465, independently corroborated by (1) a second request with numberOfResults=500 that reported the same fixed totalCount=1465 (showing totalCount does not vary with the requested page size), and (2) a third request with firstResult=1465 (past the reported end) that returned results.length=0 with totalCount still 1465, proving no further page exists. Full click-through UI pagination was not separately re-walked; instead 19 individual official product pages (17 collection representatives + both members of 2 same-base-model pairs) were independently fetched from the live browser session as raw rendered HTML and reconciled 1:1 against the structured dataset with 0 mismatches (see independentSpotChecks below). Additionally, the full 1,465 HK modelReference set was diffed against the pre-existing 1,465-entry cross-market catalog: 0 references in HK only, 0 references in the catalog only -- an exact set match, consistent with every prior market's terminal collection, and every HK familyCode matched the existing catalog collectionId for the same modelReference with 0 mismatches.

changeSafety.method: This task only used the Edit tool on data/catelog/rolex-catalog.json (appending 'HK' to sourceMarketCodes) and the Write tool to create new files under data/markets/rolex-hong-kong-market.json, data/history/HK/, and data/evidence/HK/2026-09-01/. No other Read/Edit/Write calls touched any other file in this session, so every other market/history/evidence/schema file is unmodified by construction. The catalog file grew from 10,271 to 10,272 lines (the single new 'HK' array element), matching the same +1-line growth pattern seen when GB was added to sourceMarketCodes; watches array (1,465 entries), watchCount (1,465), and collectedAt (2026-08-31T21:17:28+08:00) are unchanged because every HK modelReference already existed in the catalog (0 new configurations).

File grew by exactly 1 line (10271 -> 10272) matching the single new array element.

nicknameResearch.notes: PASS with 3 accepted collection-wide aliases and 5 accepted local nicknames (the guide's stated maximum for local nicknames). Official Rolex family names (e.g. 'Cosmograph Daytona', 'GMT-Master II', 'Day-Date') were not themselves treated as nicknames. Candidates were accepted only when at least one Hong Kong-market source was found (an HK-domiciled retailer with a physical HK address/phone, an HK-headquartered media outlet such as Esquire HK or HK01, or an HK-region page on a pan-Chinese guide site such as horoguides.com/hk), and where two same-base-reference configurations existed, only accepted when a source -- including Rolex's own official zh-hant-hk product pages for the GMT-Master II bracelet distinction -- could tie the name to one specific configuration.

independentSpotChecks.method: 17 official product pages (one per collection, matching the same representative modelReference set used in the AT/DE/US/GB runs for direct cross-market comparability) plus both members of 2 same-base-model configuration pairs were fetched as same-origin fetch() calls from inside the live chrome-devtools MCP browser session (reading raw rendered HTML, not the JSON API used to build the structured dataset) and checked for the presence of the exact modelReference and the exact HKD price string from the structured watchgrid response. The GMT-Master II Batman/Batgirl bracelet distinction used for nickname research was additionally confirmed directly from the intro text of Rolex's own official product pages (Oyster vs Jubilee).
independentSpotChecks.notes: 19 unique product pages were fetched (the 17 representatives already include both members of the day-date and sky-dweller pairs, so totalChecks equals the 19 unique pages actually fetched with no double-count). All 19 returned HTTP 200, contained the exact modelReference string, and displayed exactly the expected HKD price string. Additionally, m126710blnr-0002 and m126710blnr-0003 (both already representative/pair members above) were separately re-fetched and their intro text extracted verbatim, confirming '...蠔式（Oyster）錶帶' for -0003 and '...紀念型（Jubilee）錶帶' for -0002, which is the first-party basis for the Batman/Batgirl nickname scope.

limitations: JSON Schema validation is NOT RUN because no Draft 2020-12 validator (Python jsonschema, Node ajv) is installed and no dependency was installed without authorization; a manual field-by-field conformance check (documented above) was performed as a supplementary, non-substitute check and found 0 errors.

Full click-by-click UI pagination to a rendered count of 1,465 was not separately re-walked for HK; the structured endpoint's own totalCount === results.length terminal signal, cross-checked at a second page size and by an empty-results probe past the reported end, was used as the primary completeness proof, further cross-checked by 19 independent official product-page fetches with 0 mismatches and by an exact 1,465-to-1,465 set match against the pre-existing cross-market catalog.

Hong Kong has no VAT, GST, or general sales tax of any kind (confirmed against the Inland Revenue Department's own enumeration of administered taxes and the GovHK residents' tax pages, which list only Salaries Tax, Profits Tax, Property Tax, Stamp Duty, and several narrow duties -- no consumption tax). The official Rolex HK price-info dialog's boilerplate legal text ('已含增值税之參照零售價', i.e. 'reference price already includes VAT') is copied across Rolex's markets regardless of whether the local market actually levies a VAT/consumption tax, so it was not taken at face value; priceType is recorded as 'no-tax' with taxRatePercent 0 (a verified true zero, not an unknown treated as zero) rather than 'tax-include'.

The 'Root Beer' (CHNR bezel GMT-Master II) and a Sea-Dweller-specific '鬼王' candidate were left unaccepted rather than accepted on ambiguous or non-local-market evidence; see nicknameResearch.rejectedCandidates for the specific reasoning on each.
The repository's existing catalog directory is data/catelog/, not the guide's example catalog/ path; this predates this task and was not changed.
